answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 5078 Country: India Title: Can a man have sex with his two wives at the same time? Question: Can a man have sex with his two wives at the same time? Answer ID: 5078 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 329/329=M/1429) Having intercourse with a wife in the presence of second wife is shamelessness and against modesty. Also, it is sin for the wives to see each other?s naked body: وطئ زوجتہ بحضرۃ ضرتھا او امتہ یکرہ الخ Yes, one can have sex with both of them by turn separately provided he is permitted to do so by the wife who owns the turn. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
